name: Ukitsu Sayoko
source:
Sayoko, is same grade as Hatsune, is [url=/c10908]Kanako Ukitsu[/url]'s younger sister, but she is crisp. She is a treasurer of the student council in the second grade and is the vice-president in the third grade.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters#Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru:_Futari_no_Elder]Wikipedia[/url].]
